subject.title: North Orange County Community College District Board, Trustee Area 6

text: NOCCCD Boardmember/Engineer

Community colleges have never been more important. NOCCCD provides low-cost education to nearly 56,000 students, including returning veterans, displaced workers needing new skills, young adults preparing for university transfer, and residents of all ages who value education to improve their lives.

As your trustee, I focus on long-term effectiveness and fiscal responsibility. Community colleges belong to you, the public. A trustee's primary role is to represent and protect your interests while ensuring an excellent education for students. I have been an independent voice, asking hard questions and insisting on accountability. I am not any group’s "special interest” candidate.

Trustees oversee a $574,000,000 construction bond and a $306,000,000 annual budget. As a Registered Professional Engineer, I have the expertise needed to ensure that we receive the most benefit for each tax dollar spent.

My wife, two daughters, and I attended Fullerton College, and I have been a local homeowner for 46 years. In addition to Master's degrees in Engineering and Public Administration, I have over 45 years' experience in project management, taught in public schools, and served as a Director for two nonprofit organizations.
I want to continue my service to you and would appreciate your vote.

www.Jeff-Brown-Trustee.com
JBrown@nocccd.edu

text: Educator/Nonprofit Boardmember

My name is Paulette Chaffee, and I've dedicated much of my life to improving public education in North Orange County. I'm running for College Board to expand access to higher education and advocate for our students, as I believe firmly in both the power of education and the potential of our students.

I'm a mother, educator, attorney, and longtime community leader who has been active in dozens of local organizations. I'm also a former public school teacher and speech therapist with decades of experience in our schools. I grew up in Fullerton, raised my children here, and have deep roots in our community.

As your trustee, I'll work to:
Increase job-training programs.
Make transferring easier.
Improve counseling programs.
Support and enhance programs for our veterans.
Responsibly manage the district's budget and precious tax dollars.

I currently serve on the North Orange County Community College District's Oversight Committee where I work to ensure our tax dollars are being appropriately spent. I've also raised scholarship funds for Fullerton College students.
Our community colleges are centers of opportunity, and I am committed to seeing them thrive. I'm honored to be endorsed by many local leaders, and I would be honored to receive your vote.
Learn more at www.paulettechaffee.com.

text: Teacher/Business Owner
I have dedicated my career to uplifting the lives of students and improving our community.
First, as a teacher for Fullerton School District’s Nicolas Junior High School, where I taught math for over two decades.
Then as a Fullerton City Council Member and Mayor, where I addressed homelessness, invested in roads, and helped neighborhoods during the unprecedented challenges of COVID.

I am running for the North Orange County Community College District Board to use my unique educational and civic experience to ensure that everyone has access to high-quality and affordable education.

On our Community College Board, I will focus on providing students with the resources needed to earn an associate’s degree, further their education by transferring to a four-year college, or begin their professional career.
I will increase training programs, workforce development, student housing and partnerships with the private sector, trade associations & municipalities.

I am honored to be endorsed by Assemblymember Sharon Quirk-Silva, Congressmembers Lou Correa & Linda Sanchez, State Senator Tom Umberg, Assemblymember Avelino Valencia, Orange County Supervisors Katrina Foley & Vince Sarmiento, hardworking union families, and many more school board members, elected officials and community leaders.
I hope to earn your support as well. With your vote I will be a Board member who opens doors, creates opportunities, and speaks for all of North Orange County.
JSilva4CommunityCollege.com

text: Educator/Parent/Nurse

Education changed the course of my life, and I believe every student deserves that same opportunity to discover their potential and build a brighter future through education. Higher education opened doors I never imagined, leading to a lifetime of service, leadership, and a passion for helping others succeed.

For more than 30 years, I have served as a Registered Nurse, Nurse Manager, Adjunct Clinical Nursing Professor, educator, and mentor. From teaching middle school science and health to preparing future nurses and investing in young people through church and community programs, I have seen firsthand how education transforms lives.

My commitment extends beyond the classroom. As a Fullerton Public Library Trustee, nonprofit board member, and president of a statewide professional nursing organization, I have developed the leadership, governance, financial stewardship, and collaborative decision-making skills needed to serve our community effectively.

As your North Orange County Community College District Trustee, I will champion academic excellence, career and technical education, workforce readiness, university transfer opportunities, strategic planning and responsible stewardship of taxpayer resources. I will listen thoughtfully, lead with integrity, and always put students first.
It would be an honor to earn your trust and your vote!

Zonya Townsend
Please visit my website at Zonya.org
